concept: Multi-AZ: ASG behind ALB + RDS Multi-AZ against AZ failure
tests: Eliminating the single point of failure of all tiers in one AZ (choose two).
expected: (1) App tier in an Auto Scaling group across multiple AZs behind an ALB; (2) RDS Multi-AZ with a standby in another AZ. Triggers: "everything in a single Availability Zone", "resilience to AZ failure".
why_not: Vertically scaling the DB leaves everything in one AZ — same failure domain; instance store is ephemeral, state is lost on stop/failure.
